children: Intelligent Bio Solutions achieved above 98% accuracy, 94.6% sensitivity and 100% specificity for codeine in a multi-site Method Comparison Study.
Multi-site study across three U.S. clinical sites showed total accuracy of 98.2% versus ~94% previously.
Sensitivity improved to 94.6% (up from ~82% in prior study), reducing false negatives to 4 total.
Specificity remained 100% across all sites, with zero false positives—important for workplace testing.
Results measured against LC-MS/MS reference method and will be included in the 510(k) submission.
Company expects to submit its FDA 510(k) application in September 2026 to pursue U.S. market entry.
